vehicles.headline: Low used price; three mixed-direction restraints tested.
vehicles.summary: Worth inspecting as a cheaper used PHEV. Original HS Plus EV is a different car from the newer HS Super Hybrid. A short service interval and unrated PHEV safety status are material compromises.

range.basis: NEDC electric-only claim; Australian original Plus EV.

battery.basis: Manufacturer pack capacity; usable portion not separately verified.

depletedConsumption.basis: Observed original Essence test after depleting charge; one urban/highway route, not a certified result.

acCharging.basis: Estimate: conservative 3.7 kW planning limit. Australian reports conflict between 3.7 and 7 kW; the period manufacturer documents a 5-hour full-charge claim rather than an unambiguous maximum. Confirm on the actual car.

dcCharging.basis: No DC fast charging on the original HS Plus EV.

boot.basis: Rear seats up, to cargo cover; original PHEV, not petrol or newer HS.

bootAllRows.basis: All five seats occupied; same rear-boot measure.

towing.basis: Maximum braked; confirm actual towbar and payload limits.

vehicles.warranty: Period cover: 7 years/unlimited km. Confirm the original in-service date and booklet; current MG 10-year offers do not automatically apply to an older car.
vehicles.batteryWarranty: Period Plus EV battery cover: 7 years. Confirm kilometre, degradation and transfer conditions for the VIN; buying used does not restart cover.
vehicles.servicing: 12 months/10,000 km. At 15,000 km/year, allow roughly 1.5 scheduled visits annually; the actual bill depends on age and kilometres.
vehicles.chargeTime: Manufacturer claim: about 5 hours from a suitable wallbox, or 9 hours from household supply. Supply and temperature affect this.

safety.applicability: Unrated: ANCAP excludes the original HS PHEV/+EV from its 2019 petrol HS rating. Unrated does not mean a zero-star crash result.

familyFit.summary: Published original PHEV test fitted two rear-facing seats plus a booster. Your one rear-facing plus two other-seat arrangement remains unconfirmed.
familyFit.row2: Two outboard ISOFIX positions; three top tethers on backrests.
familyFit.testedSeats: Two rear-facing Infasecure Optima/Serene seats plus Versatile Folding Booster; article also discusses forward-facing use. Not a verified one rear-facing plus two forward-facing combination.
familyFit.buckleAccess: A booster was included, but independent buckle access for your seats was not measured.
familyFit.access: Tester found loading from inside or outside easy; 180 cm driver or 184 cm passenger fitted ahead of a rear-facing seat.
familyFit.ventilation: Rear console vents; rear USB ports.
